messages:
sam_acme: Hey team — customer noticed a billing jump this week. Their local SDK estimator shows ~1.2k tokens for a chat, but invoice shows ~2.1k. Can we repro quickly?

alex_support: ugh, thanks for the heads up. Can you paste the minimal request + how you're counting locally?

sam_acme: sure — using our JS estimator (library v0.9.2) which tokenizes prompt+reply. Sample request:```js
await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'redwood-lite-1',
  messages: [
    { role: 'system', content: 'You are a helpful assistant.' },
    { role: 'user', content: 'Summarize the following doc...' }
  ],
  stream: false
});
```
Estimator output: prompt 420 tokens, completion 780 tokens => 1200 total. Invoice line item: 2100 tokens.

alex_support: thx. Any chance the customer used functions/tooling or function_call enabled? Those can add invisible tool messages server-side.

sam_acme: they do use a reranker in prod, but this test was against a simple chat. No explicit function_call.

jordan_infra: FYI deploy-bot shows a recent runtime change: adaptive tool preamble insertion enabled for some model variants (auto-inserted system blocks when a request matches reranker heuristics). I can check logs if you give the request id.

sam_acme: request-id: req_2026-03-15_ACME_4432. I attached sanitized curl below.

sam_acme:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following doc..."}]}'
```

jordan_infra: pulled logs for req_2026-03-15_ACME_4432. Runtime shows we injected an internal system block and two tool-prefill messages before serving because the request matched adaptive_hint=rerank. Visible API response (truncated):```json
{"choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"...","prefill":[{"role":"system","content":"<internal-model-note>"},{"role":"tool","content":"reranker:seed"}]}}]}
```

alex_support: that prefill array is not returned to client libs but we count it for billing (server-side token accounting includes injected prefills and tool chain outputs). That explains the delta.

maria_billing: confirming — invoice token calc = client-visible tokens + server-inserted system/tool prefaces + any post-process outputs (e.g., re-ranks). For this request we charged ~900 tokens of injected material.

sam_acme: ahh — is there a way to surface that to the SDK estimator so it matches invoice? Or disable injection?

jordan_infra: two options: (1) pass `X-Redwood-Debug: injected-prefill=1` header to return injected messages in the response for debugging (not recommended in prod), or (2) set query param `auto_tooling=false` or pin to a model variant without adaptive prefill (e.g., `redwood-lite-1-no-tools`).

alex_support: quick repro steps for you: repro with curl + header to see extra messages:```bash
curl -H "X-Redwood-Debug: injected-prefill=1" ...```
Then run your estimator including the returned prefills. That should match invoice within a small margin.

sam_acme: tried header locally, saw two extra system/tool messages returned. Estimator now ~2088 tokens — matches invoice. Nice.

maria_billing: I'll add a billing note to the account explaining adaptive prefill billing and include pointers. Also flagging this pattern for customers using token-sensitive meterings.

alex_support: i'll follow up in a short doc: explain invisible-prefill, how to detect (X-Redwood-Debug), and mitigation (pin model / disable auto_tooling). Adding checklist for support to replicate. :white_check_mark:

sam_acme: great — thanks all. Can you also recommend best practice to avoid surprises?

jordan_infra: recommend pinning to a non-adaptive model for predictable billing, or run periodic sampled requests with debug header to measure injected overhead. We'll also add a console alert when adaptive prefill is applied to a customer's traffic.

deploy-bot: Note: rollout 2026-03-10 toggled adaptive_prefill default=on for redwood-lite-1 across edge pools. See changelog: https://internal.redwood/rollouts/2026-03-10

sam_acme: perfect — closing this thread, will reconfigure and confirm. Thanks :pray:
